outline.name: Microsoft Learn Study guide for Exam GH-300: GitHub Copilot
outline.version: Skills measured as of August 7, 2026 (page last updated 2026-07-09)
outline.notes: IDs are GH300.<domain>.<skill>.<bullet> in the order the study guide body lists them (no official numbering exists). The page's Skills at a glance list shows a stray duplicate line 'GitHub Copilot features (25-30%)'; the body has six domains, which is what is numbered here. Domain weights: responsible 15-20, features 25-30, data and architecture 10-15, prompt engineering 10-15, productivity 10-15, privacy and safeguards 10-15. Product surfaces (agent mode, Copilot CLI, Spaces, Spark, sub-agents, MCP, policies) change fast; objectives tagged 'as of the study guide date' should be rechecked against GitHub docs when the guide changes. The guide notes most questions cover GA features but commonly used Preview features may appear. GH300.2.1.3 (content exclusions in the IDE) maps to F1 and S1 since the guide lists it under the IDE skill while the course teaches exclusions under S1. Every other bullet maps 1:1 to the skill's task code.
